title: fix(gantt): full config to renderer, multi-value tooltips, bodyExtra persistence, zh/en labels
body:
Four platform gaps, each of which a downstream EHR app was working around with `node_modules` string-anchor patches. Fixing them at the source removes those patches.

## 1. ObjectView — gantt adapter dropped extended fields
`packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx` adapted `config.gantt` into renderer props via a **hardcoded 6-field whitelist** (`startDateField`, `endDateField`, `titleField`, `progressField`, `dependenciesField`, `colorField`). Everything else the renderer reads — `parentField`/`typeField`, `baseline*`, `groupByField`, `resourceView`/`assignee*`, `tooltipFields`, `quickFilters`, … — was silently dropped, so the chart flattened (no parent/child hierarchy, no summary bars).

**Fix:** spread the full `viewDef.gantt` first, then apply the three required defaults last (so an omitted source value still falls back). Mirrors the `gallery` branch directly above, which already spreads.

## 2. ObjectGantt — tooltip formatter couldn't render multi-value lookups
`formatFieldValue` only handled single-object lookups (`{name}` → `.name`). A **multi-value** lookup populated to an array (`[{name},{name}]`) is also `typeof 'object'` but has no `.name/.label/.title/.id`, so it collapsed to `'—'`.

**Fix:** add an `Array.isArray` branch that maps each element to its display value (scalars pass through) and joins them.

## 3. useConsoleActionRuntime — `bodyExtra` ignored on dataSource updates
`bodyExtra` was merged only on the absolute-HTTP branch. The generic `dataSource.update` path ignored it, so a **pure-confirmation action** (no params array — its mutation lives entirely in `bodyExtra`) produced an empty `fields` payload, the update was skipped, and nothing persisted.

**Fix:** merge `bodyExtra` last into `fields` on that path too, matching the absolute-HTTP branch and the documented "applied last; overrides user params" semantics.

## 4. i18n — missing gantt labels
Added the labels the 9.x renderer references but the bundles lacked, in both **`en`** (the canonical `TranslationKeys` source) and **`zh`**:
`toolbar.thisWeek/thisMonth/exportPdf/saveLayout`, `viewMode.year`, `menu.addPredecessor/addSuccessor/removeDependency/noCandidates`, the `linkType.*` and `conflict.*` blocks, and `readOnly`/`readOnlyHint`. (The standalone `GANTT_DEFAULT_TRANSLATIONS` fallback already had English values; this brings the locale bundles into parity so non-English locales aren't stuck on the English fallback for these keys.)

## Tests
- `ObjectGantt.test.tsx` — multi-value lookup tooltip renders joined names (array of records **and** array of scalars). plugin-gantt suite: **25 passed**.
- `useConsoleActionRuntime.test.tsx` — pure-confirmation action merges `bodyExtra` into the `dataSource.update` payload. app-shell handler suite: **13 passed**.
- i18n + plugin-gantt combined: **228 passed**; `plugin-gantt` `tsc --noEmit` clean.

Changeset included (`@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/plugin-gantt`, `@object-ui/i18n` — patch).

> Note: `packages/app-shell` has ~26 pre-existing `tsc` errors (unrelated properties: `undo`, `silent`, `actionParamOptionLabel`, …) outside the lines changed here; this PR adds none.
